input.free_text_description: The system operates in the authentication, user management domain. It serves User as its primary actors. The main business capabilities include message, person, profile. Core business data revolves around GenderConverter, Message, Person, PersonView. The system enforces access control and identity verification for protected operations.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to send and receive messages, so that I can communicate with other users in real time.
As a User, I want to upload and manage files, so that I can store and retrieve documents as needed.
As a User, I want to manage user accounts and profiles, so that user information stays current and accurate.
As a User, I want to manage person operations, so that the relevant business process is handled efficiently.
As a User, I want to manage profile operations, so that the relevant business process is handled efficiently.
